answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 4143 Country: AF Title: Which time (CHASHT NAMAZ) is jaez to pray, every day i pray at 9 am morning time, some one told me that the time of CHASHT NAMAZ enter at 10 am morning, and at 10 am i cannot pray because i am at my job, and 9 am i can pray because i am at home. so kindly please tell me can i pray at 9 am. Question: Asallamualakom, Dear Molave saheb, which time (CHASHT NAMAZ) is jaez to pray, every day i pray at 9 am morning time, some one told me that the time of CHASHT NAMAZ enter at 10 am morning, and at 10 am i cannot pray because i am at my job, and 9 am i can pray because i am at home. so kindly please tell me can i pray at 9 am. thanks Muhammad Saleem Asaki Answer ID: 4143 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 880/759=B/1429) We are not aware of your local calendar, but one can pray ?Salah of Chasht? ( صلاۃ الضحی ) till midday. During this time you can pray it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
